material.acceptance_criteria: Two session names drive two distinct targetIds, each with its own localStorage, and both pages reach the same room; the host reads joined with peers at least 1 on the peer page.
material.description: External fact: every gm browser session name in this root resolves to the same shared Chrome page (targetId 19CA9DB0...). Two fresh names drain-l-1-h552860 and drain-l-1-p552860 both reused it, and session list (dispatch 1792850542980-3155-2146d659c9ba31e4) shows 7 names on that one target. The single page reproduces the status verbatim: host url play.html?host=1#lobby reads connecting (dispatch 1792849731389-2650-a6e3c5f8b7b97c15); a peer join click reads room lobby / peers 0 (local) / joined (dispatch 1792850143224-2889-eb5442728253749a). Relays are reachable: six wss handshakes returned 101 (relay.primal.net, nos.lol, offchain.pub, nostr-pub.wellorder.net, relay.snort.social, relay.damus.io) and one socket closed before handshake. Clearing action: a gm browser primitive that gives each session its own page in an isolated context (Target.createBrowserContext plus Target.createTarget, or a profile option), then re-run this row with two pages.
material.resolution: isolated=true gives independent pages; blocker cleared.
material.subject: gm browser verbs cannot give two independent peer pages, so the two-profile witness for peer-join-connecting-no-peer cannot run
material.witness: Two isolated sessions, distinct targetIds (host 08D8F63253D90D149795C6B66FEC1164, peer 9BC6CD8426A9B1BB05625E2E59BC8D42), distinct browserContextIds. Host reads peers 4 (local) with peer-open 628950e1; peer reads peers 4 (net) with the same peer-open (dispatch 1792893704025-6236-e6554aea722c3b87). Acceptance met.
material.witness_plan: Two gm browser sessions on play.html host=1#lobby and play.html#lobby; read each targetId, #status and the wss frame counts after 20 s.
